Thirsty.text: I am so thirsty. I wish there was something to drink around here.
Thirsty.title: Dehydrated

Starving.title: Starving
Starving.text: I am starving. I wish there was something to eat around here.

Exhausted.title: Exhausted
Exhausted.text: So so tired, I can hardly keep my eyes open.

ColonistDied.title: Colonist died
ColonistDied.text: A member of the crew has died. Maybe it will be me next time.

LowOxygen.title: Low Oxygen
LowOxygen.text: I am really struggling to breath.

Optimistic.title: Optimistic
Optimistic.text: I am feeling pretty happy about how things are going right now.

PlentyOfReserves.note: We need to check how many colonists there are and then make sure there is enough food for at least a week or two?
PlentyOfReserves.title: Plenty of reserves
PlentyOfReserves.text: It's great that we have plenty of food and water reserves on the ship.

Content.note: If they have above 60% food and water for more than so many days??
Content.title: Content
Content.text: I am well watered and have food in my belly. Everything seems to be going ok for now.

AteOnFloor.title: Eaten on the floor.
AteOnFloor.text: It sucks having to eat on the floor.

SharesRoom.title: Shares a room.
SharesRoom.text: I really need my own privacy.

SleptOnFloor.title: Slept on the floor.
SleptOnFloor.text: I really wish i had a bed. It sucks having to sleep on the floor.

SleptInComfyBed.title: Slept on the floor.
SleptInComfyBed.text: Wow, my bed is so comfy. I could sleep in it all day.

SharingBed.title: Slept on the floor.
SharingBed.text: I hate having to share a bed, it stinks.

Cramped.title: Cramped.
Cramped.text: I can hardly move in this place.

UnsatisfiedWithRole.title: Unsatisfied with given role.
UnsatisfiedWithRole.text: I really think I deserve a higher ranking role than the one I have been given.

SatisfiedWithRole.title: Satisfied with given role.
SatisfiedWithRole.text: I am really happy with the role I have been given.

Depressed.title: Depressed.
Depressed.text: My life sucks and I hate it!
